name: Exp_ColorTSI-Oscillator
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorTSI-Oscillator indicator, which is a True Strength Index oscillator with dual smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorTSI-Oscillator指标（双重平滑的真实强度指数振荡器）进行交易。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿信号线时开空仓，配有可配置的止损止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于TSI（真实强度指数）振荡器的动量交叉信号。入场条件为：当指标线(Ind)上穿信号线(Sign)时触发买入信号，当指标线下穿信号线时触发卖出信号。出场条件包括反向信号平仓以及固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理方面，EA提供了5种手数计算模式，包括基于可用保证金、账户余额、亏损比例等方式，默认使用固定手数(LOT)。资金管理通过MM参数控制存款占比（默认0.1）。EA采用多周期架构，允许在不同于图表的时间周期上运行指标。信号计算仅在新增K线时执行，避免重复计算。该策略依赖动量振荡器的交叉信号，属于典型的动量跟踪系统，在趋势转换时可能产生较多虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on crossover signals from the TSI (True Strength Index) oscillator with dual configurable smoothing methods. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the indicator line (Ind) crosses above the signal line (Sign), and a sell signal is triggered when it crosses below. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse crossover signals and using fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) levels. Position sizing supports five lot calculation modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-share-based methods, with the default set to fixed lot (LOT). Money management is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the deposit share (default 0.1). The EA employs a multi-timeframe architecture allowing the indicator to run on a different timeframe than the chart. Signal calculations are only executed on new bars to avoid redundant processing. The strategy relies on momentum oscillator crossover signals, making it a typical momentum-following system that may generate numerous false signals during trend transitions.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算方法（可用保证金/余额/亏损比例/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/margin w/ floating P&L/balance w/ floating P&L/fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Max allowed price deviation (slippage) in points

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 提供5种灵活的资金管理模式，适应不同风险偏好
使用新K线检测机制避免信号重复计算，减少冗余交易
支持10种平滑算法和多种价格类型，参数可调性强
买卖方向可独立开关，便于单向交易或对冲策略
止损止盈参数明确，风险控制有基本框架
pros_en: Provides 5 flexible money management modes adaptable to different risk preferences
Uses new bar detection to avoid redundant signal calculation and prevent duplicate trades
Supports 10 smoothing algorithms and multiple price types with strong parameter configurability
Buy and sell directions can be independently enabled/disabled for directional or hedging strategies
Explicit stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 动量振荡器交叉信号在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号
止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动率动态调整
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
默认SignalBar=1导致信号确认延迟，而设为0时又可能过于频繁交易
未对指标句柄失败后的恢复做处理，仅返回INIT_FAILED
cons_en: Momentum oscillator crossover signals tend to produce frequent false signals in ranging markets
Fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) are not dynamically adjusted for market volatility
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, may open positions under unfavorable conditions
Default SignalBar=1 causes signal confirmation delay, while setting it to 0 may cause overly frequent trading
No recovery mechanism for indicator handle failure beyond returning INIT_FAILED
improvements: 增加波动率自适应的止损止盈机制（如基于ATR动态调整），提高对不同市况的适应性
添加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在高点差和非活跃时段开仓
增加趋势过滤指标（如大周期MA方向），仅在趋势方向一致时开仓以减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Add volatility-adaptive stop loss/take profit mechanism (e.g., ATR-based dynamic adjustment) for better market adaptability
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid opening positions during high spread or inactive sessions
Add a trend filter indicator (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction) to only trade in alignment with the dominant trend, reducing false signals

risk_points: 固定止损止盈不适应不同市场波动环境，低波动时止损过大可能造成不必要损失
动量交叉策略在震荡市中容易频繁开平仓导致连续亏损
缺少点差过滤，在流动性不足时段滑点可能显著增加交易成本
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit does not adapt to varying market volatility; oversized stops in low-volatility conditions may cause unnecessary losses
Momentum crossover strategies tend to generate frequent opening and closing of positions in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Lack of spread filter may result in significant slippage costs during low-liquidity sessions
